title: Jio IPO day 2: 3.7x subscribed, retail portion fully booked; Paras Healthcare at 0.21x
dek: Institutions bid 9.6 times their quota by midday; one day left for both IPOs.
body: Jio Platforms' IPO was subscribed 3.7 times by 12:10 pm on its second day, Business Standard reported: institutions (QIBs) 9.6 times, HNIs 2.87 times and retail investors 1.11 times. The retail portion crossing 1 means every share set aside for small investors has now been applied for.

Paras Healthcare's IPO was 0.21 times subscribed at 11:30 am, according to ScanX: retail 1.00 times, HNIs 0.20 times and institutions yet to bid. Institutions often bid on the last day, so the total can change sharply on Friday.

Worked example: with retail at 1.11 times, there are about 111 applications' worth of shares for every 100 available, so not every applicant will get a lot. Allotment is decided by lottery on 26 October.
Key takeaway: Jio's demand is broad across categories; Paras depends on institutions arriving on the final day.
indiaImpact: Jio's strong demand shows deep investor appetite for large Indian listings, while weak early interest in Paras shows that demand is selective.
